{{Quote|Ah, my son and heir! I was hoping you'd be here for the festivities. We'll tell the musicians to strike up the old songs, the ones our spawn-fathers knew, and we'll do the lizard dance all around the courtyard&mdash;|A drunken Cradossk greets Bossk, who knocks Cradossk's wine goblet from his claws|<ref name="TMS">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>}}
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The mention of the lizard dance in ''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]'' takes place shortly after [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] leader of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], mentioned the '''lizard dance''' when his son, [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], entered his chamber in the Guild's [[Bounty Hunters' Guild complex|complex]]. Cradossk was celebrating [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] decision to join the Guild and was [[Alcohol/Legends|drunk]] on [[Wine/Legends|wine]] when he said that he and Bossk would do this dance around the courtyard.<ref name="TMS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lizard dance was mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]'', which was written by [[K. W. Jeter]] as the first novel in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Wars]]'' trilogy.<ref name="TMS" />
